name: TOWA Corporation
blurb: TOWA Corporation is a Japanese semiconductor equipment manufacturer specializing in encapsulation molding systems and related tooling. The company provides precision molding presses, dies, and automation solutions for the semiconductor packaging industry. TOWA holds a leading position in the global market for compression molding equipment used in advanced chip packaging.
recent: In September 2025, TOWA shares surged 35% following a period of weakness, pushing its P/E ratio to 28.5x, well above the Japanese market average of 14x. The jump reflects optimism that the company's earnings, which declined 20% in the past year and 31% over three years, will recover strongly with analysts forecasting 17% annual EPS growth over the next three years.
